rulesClauses: Up to one target opponent discards a card from their hand or memory.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The targeted opponent was offered the discard as an MZMAYCHOOSE, so they could PASS and keep every card, and TopsyDecreeDiscard was queued without dontSkipOnPass so a PASS also dropped the rest of the chosen modes (live repro on HEAD: PASS accepted, nothing discarded, queue empty). The discard is now a forced MZCHOOSE, and because GameValidateDecisionAnswer() accepts PASS for every decision type the handler re-asks while the opponent still has a card to discard.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php TopsyDecree_ProcessNext case 1 and the TopsyDecreeDiscard handler
